code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    fg = min((v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != bg), key=lambda v: -sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == fg]
    # Mark all gaps between same-color points on a common row or column.
    for r in range(h):
        cs = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == fg]
        for a, b in zip(cs, cs[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                if grid[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(w):
        rs = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == fg]
        for a, b in zip(rs, rs[1:]):
            for r in range(a + 1, b):
                if grid[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = 2
    # Join close perpendicular stroke ends with the same elbow-shaped gap fill.
    hs = [(r,c) for r,c in pts if (c > 0 and grid[r][c-1] == fg) or (c+1 < w and grid[r][c+1] == fg)]
    vs = [(r,c) for r,c in pts if (r > 0 and grid[r-1][c] == fg) or (r+1 < h and grid[r+1][c] == fg)]
    for r1,c1 in hs:
        for r2,c2 in vs:
            if r1 == r2 or c1 == c2 or abs(r1-r2) + abs(c1-c2) > 3: continue
            # H point to V point: extend the horizontal arm to the V column, then the vertical arm.
            for c in range(min(c1,c2), max(c1,c2)+1):
                if grid[r1][c] == bg: out[r1][c] = 2
            for r in range(min(r1,r2), max(r1,r2)+1):
                if grid[r][c2] == bg: out[r][c2] = 2
    return out
'''
